caption: The drawing depicts a model of a rooster mounted on a rectangular wooden base. The rooster is shown with its right leg forward, as if in mid-stride. The rooster's head, neck, legs, and parts of the tail are colored in a pale grayish-white, while the comb and most of the body including the wings and primary tail feathers are shaded in a reddish-brown color with visible anatomical muscle striations rendered in detail. The wooden base is colored in shades of brown, with a slightly darker tone on its front edge. The background is a plain light beige color. The drawing is composed to display the rooster in profile, facing to the left. The anatomical features of the rooster are carefully outlined, with particular attention to muscle structure and feather layering.
title: Rooster
